text: 子弹击中后，陌生人踉跄着向后退去，脸上带着惊骇的表情，随后倒下。你急忙上前。简单检查便证实了最坏的结果。你杀死——谋杀了——一名无辜的人，他很可能是迷路的猎人或勘探者。你回头看向惊恐的学生们。
如果你们能回到文明世界，西尔维娅和诺曼就不得不把事情经过说出来。即使事出有因，能够以过失杀人辩护，你要坐多少年牢？

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 79
text: The stranger stumbles backward under the bullet’s impact and collapses with a thunderstruck grimace. You hurry to him. A brief examination confirms the worst. You have killed— murdered—an innocent man, probably a lost woodsman or prospector. You glance back at the horrified students.
If you get back to civilization, Sylvia and Norman will be obliged to recount what happened. Even if circumstances allow a manslaughter plea, how many years will that mean in prison?
